_comment: Baseline of LaunchOps hard-gate pass/fail state as of 2026-04-23. CI gate (scripts/ci/verify_launchops_gates_baseline.sh) compares .launchops/gates.json against this file and fails on: (a) any gate flipping pass -> fail (hard regression), or (b) any baseline gate disappearing (definition change without review). Newly-passing gates and newly-added gates are flagged but do not fail the build; the baseline should be refreshed with UPDATE_BASELINE=1 in the same PR so the new floor is locked in. Mirrors the deep_red_flags baseline discipline.

bridge_replay_tests.accepted_reason: Green as of 2026-04-23 mainnet-gating scan; must not regress.

clippy_clean.accepted_reason: Workspace-wide clippy broken pending Wave 0 cleanup (scorecard Gate 7 yellow). Baselined as fail; flip to pass when cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings exits 0.

cross_vm_atomic_tests.accepted_reason: Green as of 2026-04-23; must not regress.

dex_liquidity_lock_tests.accepted_reason: Green as of 2026-04-23; must not regress.

formatting_clean.accepted_reason: cargo fmt --all -- --check reports drift; baselined as fail pending Wave 0 formatting pass.

no_p0_blockers.accepted_reason: blockers.json is empty; must not regress without explicit review.

no_production_stubs.accepted_reason: 227 critical red flags remain (scorecard Gate 6/7 red). Baselined as fail; the red_flags burn-down is owed before mainnet.

workspace_compiles.accepted_reason: cargo check --workspace --all-targets fails (pallet-x3-coin mocks + x3-integration EVM executor wiring). Scorecard Gate 7 yellow. Baselined as fail pending Wave 0 workspace burn-down.

workspace_tests_pass.accepted_reason: cargo test --workspace fails while workspace compile fails. Baselined as fail; will flip once workspace_compiles is green.
